Never the *leftover turkey hash* tucked in the back. Just pie. Predictable. She left a fingerprint on the plastic cover. A *smudge*. They treat it like a holy relic. Me? Last week, a girl licked her finger to turn its pages. *Licked it.* Like it was sacred. I’d rather be licked than ignored. At least then I’d *feel* something.

Fitting.

My hands are only touched when spiders walk across me. Or when the vacuum hose *almost* grazes my top edge during cleanups. Close calls. Almost famous.
